pli-tv-bu-vb-sk45:1.3.1: According to Sp 2.621 this means repeatedly breaking pieces off a ball of food. The word avacchedaka is further explained at Vin-vn-ṭ 1920 as chinditvā, “having broken off”. This, it seems, can only refer to breaking off pieces, not to biting. Each ball of food was a single mouthful, consisting of rice with suitable curry.

pli-tv-bu-vb-sk45:1.12: For phalāphale see PED, sv. ā⁴.
